verdict.rationale: Codex CLI has a dedicated review command that reports prioritized findings against a commit or base branch without modifying the working tree, and Codex Cloud can be started from GitHub pull requests/issues, suggesting review-oriented workflows tied to PRs. However, there's no direct evidence of automatic triggering on every PR with contextual feedback posted back to the PR (e.g., inline PR comments), only a manual/on-demand review command and general PR-triggered task start. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic per-PR review triggering, evidence of inline PR comment posting, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
